g.text: Throughput: aisleflow wins where aisles are scarce, and loses where they are not

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Taller is better: tasks delivered per 1000 timesteps, so 149 means 149 tasks out of every 1000 steps of simulated time.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Each map shows the best aisleflow configuration on that map, named under its bar, with a permutation test against plain PIBT. The two wins are ahead by 21-27%

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: but land at p = 0.06 on five seeds; the two losses are significant. Both baselines are far behind everywhere.
